settings.question: How much does a winter tire change cost in Calgary?
settings.answer: A changeover at Prince Tires is a flat rate by vehicle: $60 for most cars, SUVs, vans and EVs, $80 for trucks and larger trucks, $90 for dual-rear-wheel (dually) trucks, and $120 for trailers. That covers the swap itself — your tires already mounted on their own rims, moved onto your vehicle and torqued to spec. You'll see the exact price when you book online.

settings.question: Do you do the swap back in spring too?
settings.answer: Yes — same flat rate, same 30 minutes, and the calendar is far easier than it is in October. The swap back is usually April, once overnight lows stop dropping below 7°C. For the full timing question — when to put winter tires on and when to take them off — see winter and snow tires in Calgary, which covers both ends of the season.

settings.question: What's the difference between a changeover and tire installation?
settings.answer: A changeover assumes your winter and summer tires each sit on their own set of rims — we just swap which set is on the vehicle. Tire installation is for loose tires that aren't on rims yet: we mount them, balance them, and set up the wheels from scratch — see tire installation in Calgary for that pricing. If you're not sure which one you need, give us a call and describe what you've got.

settings.question: How long does a seasonal tire swap take?
settings.answer: A standard car or SUV changeover takes about 30 minutes. Trucks and duallies take a little longer. Book a time slot online and there's no waiting around — drop the vehicle, we swap the wheels, torque everything to spec, and you're back on the road.

settings.question: Do you store my off-season tires?
settings.answer: No — Prince Tires doesn't offer tire storage, so your off-season set goes home with you. Store them somewhere cool, dry and out of direct sunlight — a garage corner or basement works well. If they're on rims, stack them flat or hang them; loose tires are best kept standing upright.

settings.question: Can you swap tires I bought somewhere else?
settings.answer: Yes. It doesn't matter where your tires or rims came from — another shop, a dealership, online, or a used set. As long as your seasonal tires are mounted on rims that fit your vehicle, we'll change them over at the same flat rate, with no outside-purchase surcharge.

settings.heading: Winter Tire Change Calgary — Seasonal Changeover
settings.subheading: Booking a winter tire change or spring swap? Prince Tires changes over your seasonal tire-and-rim sets from $60 flat, in about 30 minutes — every wheel torqued to spec — same-day at our SW Calgary shop.
settings.pricing_title: Winter tire change cost in Calgary
settings.pricing_intro: A winter tire change (seasonal changeover) is the straightforward swap: your winter and summer tires each live on their own set of rims, and we move the correct set onto your vehicle and torque every wheel to spec. It's a flat rate by vehicle — $60 for most cars, SUVs, vans and EVs, $80 for trucks, and $90 for dual-rear-wheel trucks. Your tires do need to be mounted on rims already; if they're loose, book a tire installation instead.

settings.lead: On their own rims — this is a changeover
settings.text: Four mounted wheels come off, four go on, every nut torqued to spec. Nothing is dismounted, so nothing needs rebalancing. Flat $60 for most vehicles, about 30 minutes.

settings.lead: Sharing one set of rims — that is an installation
settings.text: Each tire has to be dismounted from the rim and the other one mounted and balanced in its place. More labour, and it works the tire beads twice a year. That is the installation rate.

settings.lead: A second set of rims usually pays for itself
settings.text: Steel rims are inexpensive and shrug off road salt. After the first winter, every changeover is the cheaper job instead of the dearer one.

settings.lead: Either way the wheels get torqued, not gunned
settings.text: And the same re-torque check at 50 to 100 km applies.

settings.heading: Changeover or installation? They are different jobs
settings.intro: The price difference comes down to one question: are your seasonal tires already on their own rims?
settings.outro:
Not sure which you have? Look at your off-season tires. If they are sitting on wheels, it is a changeover.

If a set that rode fine last season shakes at highway speed once it goes back on, give it 20 minutes or more of highway driving first; most storage flat spots warm out. If it doesn't settle, a standard balance is the first step and road force balancing at Edmonton Trail NE is the next.

settings.lead: The rush is mid-October to mid-November
settings.text: Appointments tighten first, then walk-in waits get long. The work does not get slower; the queue gets longer.

settings.lead: The first snowfall is the worst day to call
settings.text: Demand spikes the same morning. Anyone who booked in advance is already scheduled.
Walk-ins are welcome and we fit them around booked work, but a slot is the difference between dropping the car and waiting.
The swap back runs roughly April, once overnight lows stop dipping under 7°C. Less pressure on the calendar, and leaving winter tires on into summer wears them quickly.

settings.heading: Booking around the October rush
settings.intro: Every tire shop in Calgary sees the same three weeks. Temperatures drop under 7°C, the first snow is forecast, and the whole city books at once.
settings.outro: Book a changeover or call (403) 452-4283. For which tires to run and when to fit them, see winter and snow tires in Calgary.
